runtimeCatalog.role: Immutable compatibility input: IDs, selection, order and values checked against the CSV; not the source of scientific sidecar values.

generator.serialization: UTF-8 compact JSON, insertion-ordered keys, finite numbers, final LF, no timestamps/absolute paths

qualityPolicy.sentinelRule: dist >= 100000 means missing or dubious parallax; retain raw value, exclude from default scientific distance selection.
qualityPolicy.catalogDistanceMeaning: A retained catalog distance, not certified accuracy.
qualityPolicy.uncertainty: No error/covariance columns exist in this source; uncertainty is null, never zero.
qualityPolicy.crossIdentifiers: Source assertions retained without new cross-matching; duplicates are allowed and must not replace HYG identity.
qualityPolicy.coordinateMismatch: Euclidean raw RA/Dec/distance to raw XYZ residual exceeds an application diagnostic bound derived from serialized decimal steps. Neither bound nor lack of flag is scientific uncertainty or accuracy certification.
qualityPolicy.roundingBoundFormula: half(dist decimal step) + abs(dist)*(half(RA step)*pi/12 + half(Dec step)*pi/180) + norm(half(XYZ steps)) + 16*machine_epsilon*max(1,abs(dist))
qualityPolicy.sourceMotionZeros: Zero motion/velocity fields are retained as source values; they do not certify a measured zero or known uncertainty.
qualityPolicy.canonicalSun: Synthetic heliocentric origin has sourceId null and related source row 0. Scientific separation is 0 pc. Legacy runtime dist=0.0000048481 pc and photometry are explicit compatibility conventions, not a stellar parallax measurement.

selectionPolicy.missingColorIndexNote: Legacy rendering excludes rows missing color index. This is a presentation-selection policy, not proof those stars are scientifically invalid.
